style: Photorealistic isometric 3D render of one single industrial building, game asset, seen from above at a three-quarter angle, the front of the building faces the bottom right. Physically based materials: weathered grey concrete panels with rivets, dark bitumen flat roof, blue painted steel trim with small chips and scratches, dirt and wear, sharp high detail textures, sober grey and blue industrial colour palette. Neutral soft studio lighting, no cast shadow on the background. Built directly on a bare flat concrete base, nothing around it. The whole building is fully visible and centred with wide empty margin on every side. The building occupies only the central 60 percent of the image width and is free-standing, with no other structure visible. Plain flat pure white background.

images.name: hub_lvl2
images.description: A mid-sized logistics warehouse with two loading docks with roller doors and yellow safety bollards, a small office annex on the side, skylights and an air conditioning unit on the roof.

images.name: hub_lvl3
images.description: A large logistics warehouse with four loading docks in a row, roller doors, yellow and black striped dock bumpers, a two-storey office annex with windows, roof skylights and ventilation units.

images.name: hub_lvl4
images.description: A very large modern distribution centre with six loading docks, tall metal cladding walls with a wide blue stripe, a glass-fronted office block at one corner, solar panels and ventilation units on the roof.

images.name: hub_lvl5
images.description: A huge high-tech logistics hub with eight loading docks, sleek metal and glass facade, a glass office tower at one corner, rooftop solar panel arrays, antennas and a helipad marking on the roof.

images.name: fueltank_lvl0
images.description: The ruins of a small fuel depot: a cracked square concrete slab with rubble, a rusty dented fuel tank lying on its side, broken pipes and a collapsed low concrete wall.

images.name: fueltank_lvl1
images.description: A tiny makeshift fuel point: a single old rusty oil barrel with a hand pump on a small square concrete slab, a red jerrycan next to it, a low concrete kerb around the slab.

images.name: fueltank_lvl2
images.description: A small fuel point: one white plastic cube fuel tank in a metal cage on a square concrete slab, a simple hose and nozzle, a low concrete kerb around the slab.

images.name: fueltank_lvl3
images.description: A small fuel station: one horizontal cylindrical steel fuel tank on steel legs on a square concrete slab, a single fuel pump next to it, pipes and a red fire extinguisher box.

images.name: fueltank_lvl4
images.description: A fuel station with an underground tank: a square concrete slab with round steel manhole covers and vent pipes, one modern fuel pump on a raised island, a small metal canopy above the pump.

images.name: fueltank_lvl5
images.description: A private fuel station: two fuel pumps on a raised island under a flat blue-trimmed canopy, a horizontal steel fuel tank behind them, yellow safety bollards, a square concrete slab.

images.name: fueltank_lvl6
images.description: A professional fuel station: four fuel pumps on two islands under a large flat canopy with a blue stripe, two large horizontal steel fuel tanks behind, pipes and a small control cabin.

images.name: fueltank_lvl7
images.description: An industrial fuel depot: one big vertical cylindrical double-wall steel storage tank with a staircase winding around it, a concrete containment wall around its base, a pump station with four pumps under a canopy in front.

images.name: fueltank_lvl8
images.description: A regional fuel depot: two big vertical cylindrical steel storage tanks with staircases and walkways, a concrete containment wall, a long canopy with six fuel pumps in front, pipe racks and a control building.

images.name: fueltank_lvl9
images.description: Seen from a corner at 45 degrees, three-quarter isometric view from above, not a flat front view. A fuel terminal: three large vertical cylindrical steel storage tanks linked by walkways and pipe racks, a concrete containment wall, a tanker loading gantry, a long canopy with fuel pumps and a control building with antennas.

images.name: fueltank_lvl10
images.description: Seen from a corner at 45 degrees, three-quarter isometric view from above, not a flat front view. A huge private fuel hub: four very large white vertical cylindrical storage tanks with blue stripes, complex pipe racks and walkways, a tanker loading gantry, a wide modern canopy with many fuel pumps, a glass control tower.

images.name: office_lvl0
images.description: The ruins of a small office building: a cracked square concrete slab with rubble, broken low brick walls, a fallen door and a few broken window frames.

images.name: office_lvl1
images.description: A small single-storey office building for a trucking company: flat roof, a row of windows, a blue front door with a small awning, an air conditioning unit on the roof, a short paved entrance.
